sources.observation: The pointed horseshoe portal has a double carved border. Paired bastions project out from the crenellated curtain and each merlon ends in a small pyramid.

sources.credit: Carlos ZGZ, see linked file for license
sources.observation: Low Roman walls sit above the square Marinid minaret and its tiled upper lantern. Carved lozenges and paired blind arches mark the tower faces.

limitations: Terrarium elevations guide the slope and foundations. The minaret footprint and height, surviving ruin courses, and individual merlons are photo-based exterior approximations.
